column1: # devices/goat_elegant/hal/codes.tsv: every HAL code the Lumen apps of the Z9X HB (G0130 / G0118 / G0148, MT9660): stable AIDL xgimi.hardware.gmpf V1 send.
# One row = one named constant. tools/hal/gen_codes.py --write writes the HalCodes class of each app on a java line from
# the rows naming that app; --check fails when a class differs. tools/hal/check_codes.py proves every row against its
# stock table (same interface, code and method; AIDL also the signature) and refuses any HAL call in any app whose
# code is not a HalCodes constant. NAME = interface prefix + "_" + the stock method in capitals (underscores only
# for reading): if a call does not work, the row of its constant is the place to look. A new call = a new row here.
#   java<TAB>APP<TAB>PATH[<TAB>public]          the generated class (package from PATH, class name from the file name)
#   stock<TAB>INTERFACE|*<TAB>TABLE[<TAB>PROXY]  the stock code table the rows are proven against
# columns: interface (stock name; "-" = AIDL meta call, valid on every interface), NAME, code, stock method,
# args (stock wire layout W= / R= or AIDL signature), kind (get / set / call / meta), apps, source (evidence)
